records.jp: 星崎さん、このロケットって<CR>本物……ではないですよね？
records.en_original: Ao, this rocket... It can't be real, can it?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, this rocket... It can't be real, can it?

records.jp: これ？　えーっと……
records.en_original: This? Uh...
records.en: This? Uh...

records.jp: （もちろん本物じゃないはず、<CR>　なんだけど……）
records.en_original: (There's probably no way this thing is real, but...)
records.en: (There's probably no way this thing is real, but...)

records.jp: 残念だけど、どう考えても本物じゃないよね……
records.en_original: Sorry to say, but I can't see it being real.
records.en: Sorry to say, but I can't see it being real.

records.jp: ……そう、ですか。<CR>少し残念です
records.en_original: Ah, I see. That's too bad...
records.en: Ah, I see. That's too bad...

records.jp: え？　どういうこと？
records.en_original: Hmm? Why do say that?
records.en: Hmm? Why do say that?

records.jp: 実はこれ、本物……
records.en_original: Actually, this is the real thing.
records.en: Actually, this is the real thing.

records.jp: えっ
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ──って言ったら、どうする？
records.en_original: ...Is what I would say if it were real.
records.en: ...Is what I would say if it were real.

records.jp: もし、これが本物だったら……
records.en_original: But if this were real...
records.en: But if this were real...

records.jp: 中を見てみたかったんです。<CR>本物のロケットには乗ったことありませんし
records.en_original: I would have liked to take a look inside. I've never seen the inside of a real rocket.
records.en: I would have liked to take a look inside. I've never seen the inside of a real rocket.

records.jp: あ！　それじゃあ……
records.en_original: Well, in that case...
records.en: Well, in that case...

records.jp: 一緒に行っちゃう？　宇宙旅行！
records.en_original: How about a trip to space together?
records.en: How about a trip to space together?

records.jp: とんでもなくお金がかかりそうですね
records.en_original: A trip to space would have to be unbelievably expensive...
records.en: A trip to space would have to be unbelievably expensive...

records.jp: あうっ！　現実的なツッコミ！<CR>宇宙旅行ごっこだよう、ごっこ！
records.en_original: Hey, I wasn't being serious! I meant we could just pretend!
records.en: Hey, I wasn't being serious! I meant we could just pretend!

records.jp: 宇宙旅行ごっこ……
records.en_original: A pretend space adventure?
records.en: A pretend space adventure?

records.jp: いいですね、やりましょう。<CR>……ごっこ遊び、初めてかもしれません
records.en_original: That sounds nice. Let's do it. I don't believe I've ever played pretend before.
records.en: That sounds nice. Let's do it. I don't believe I've ever played pretend before.

records.jp: ロケットの中で、おかしパーティーする？<CR>二人だけで、こっそり！
records.en_original: How about we have a tea party inside the rocket! It'll be our secret!
records.en: How about we have a tea party inside the rocket! It'll be our secret!

records.jp: 食事当番の人に怒られそうですね。<CR>でも……
records.en_original: Though the cooking team may get mad at us for using their supplies…
records.en: Though the cooking team may get mad at us for using their supplies…

records.jp: 星崎さんの提案は、何故かいつも心惹かれます。<CR>ご一緒してもいいですか？
records.en_original: Your schemes always impress me. Shall we?
records.en: For some reason, Hoshizaki-san's suggestions always captivate me. May I join you?

records.jp: えへへ！　もっちろん！
records.en_original: Hehe! Of course!
records.en: Hehe! Of course!

records.jp: 星崎さん、早くロケットの中に入りましょう……！
records.en_original: Let's board then...!
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, let us get inside the rocket quickly...!

records.jp: （想像以上に乗り気だ。<CR>提案してよかった……あ！）
records.en_original: (Uta's way more into this than I'd thought she'd be. I'm glad I came up with this!)
records.en: (Uta's way more into this than I'd thought she'd be. I'm glad I came up with this!)

records.jp: 詩さん、ちょっと待って！
records.en_original: Wait up, Uta!
records.en: Wait up, Uta-san!

records.jp: 今からすっ……ごく大事なことを伝えるから、<CR>詩さんはそこで見てて？
records.en_original: I'm about to show you something super important, okay? Look over there.
records.en: I am about to tell you something really important, so watch from there, Uta-san.

records.jp: え？　は、はい
records.en_original: Hmm? A-all right.
records.en: Hmm? A-all right.

records.jp: いっくよー？<CR>いないいない……
records.en_original: Here it comes! Peek-a-...
records.en: Here it comes! Peek-a-...

records.jp: ばあ！<CR>なーんてね
records.en_original: Boo! Heh, just messing around.
records.en: Boo! Heh, just messing around.

records.jp: う、詩さん？<CR>何かリアクションなど頂けると……
records.en_original: U-Uta? I would appreciate it if you said something...
records.en: U-Uta-san? I would appreciate it if you said something...

records.jp: 星崎さん、「いないいない」ができてませんよ。<CR>最初から顔が丸見えでした
records.en_original: Ao, I could see your face the whole time. That makes for a poor game of peek-a-boo.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, I could see your face the whole time. That makes for a poor game of peek-a-boo.

records.jp: 欲しかったツッコミはソレじゃないんだけど<CR>……クール可愛いからよし！
records.en_original: That wasn't exactly the reaction I was going for, but... It was still cute, so I forgive you!
records.en: That wasn't exactly the reaction I was going for, but... It was still cute, so I forgive you!

records.jp: まずはしっかり準備しなきゃ！
records.en_original: Let's get everything ready first!
records.en: Let's get everything ready first!

records.jp: 準備ですか？
records.en_original: Do we have much to prepare?
records.en: Do we have much to prepare?

records.jp: そう！　おかしに、トランプに……
records.en_original: Yeah! Like snacks, playing cards...
records.en: Yeah! Like snacks, playing cards...

records.jp: ……それから、美味しい飲み物？
records.en_original: And some refreshing drinks?
records.en: And some refreshing drinks?

records.jp: そうそれ！
records.en_original: Yeah, that too!
records.en: Yeah, that too!

records.jp: ふふっ
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 星崎さんが楽しそうで、つい
records.en_original: You looked like you were having so much fun, I couldn't help but laugh.
records.en: You looked like you were having fun, Hoshizaki-san, so I couldn't help myself.

records.jp: 宇宙空間には音がないって言いますけど、<CR>星崎さんとなら、きっとそんなこと気になりませんね
records.en_original: They say space is lonely, but I'm sure I wouldn't have to worry about that if you were with me.
records.en: They say there is no sound in space, but with you, Hoshizaki-san, I probably wouldn't mind that.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
